subject.title: WhatsApp pairing can stick at Logging in until gateway restart finalizes 515 recovery

question: Should this issue remain the separate WhatsApp 515/manual-gateway-restart acceptance tracker, or should that requirement be folded into https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85867 and its open implementation PRs?
rationale: Current main lacks the phone-code path, current 515 coverage is mocked QR/in-process recovery, and the active PRs add public auth/session surface without yet proving this exact live finalization behavior.

options.title: Keep Separate Acceptance Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until a phone-code PR or narrower WhatsApp recovery fix proves the 515 finalization path no longer needs an operator gateway restart.

options.title: Fold Into Phone-Code Issue
options.body: Treat the restart-free 515 behavior as an explicit acceptance criterion on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85867 and close this only after maintainers update that canonical lane.

options.title: Split A Narrow Recovery Fix
options.body: Leave the phone-code entrypoint to the existing PRs and track a WhatsApp-owned recovery fix for 515 credential finalization separately.

recommendation.title: Keep Separate Acceptance Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until a phone-code PR or narrower WhatsApp recovery fix proves the 515 finalization path no longer needs an operator gateway restart.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns recent WhatsApp lifecycle history and the active maintainer replacement PR that would most likely carry or reject this acceptance criterion.
